## Courses

[**Sustainable Processes**](mec1019/index.qmd)
: Design project — study notes and interactive applets on microcontrollers

[**Electrical Power and Electromechanical Systems**](mec1002/index.qmd)
: Lecture notes with interactive elements: DC motors, AC circuits and power,
  transformers, three-phase systems, induction and synchronous motors

[**Manufacturing Automation for Assembly and Inspection**](mec1043-1062/index.qmd)
: Course notes with 77 interactive applets: logic control and ladder logic,
  PLCs, industrial networks, parts feeding and assembly systems
